messages:
neha: FYI I'm kicking off a rebuild of our runtime base images tonight (01:00 UTC). Goal: OCI minification + drop unnecessary packages + address recent image-scan findings. Need RBAC updates for KMS envelope decryption in the sidecar and audit log routing.

owen: I can take the RBAC/IAM side. Are we on CMK or AWS-managed? Which key ARN?

neha: Customer-managed CMK for prod. (redacted) arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/REDACTED. We need kms:Decrypt for the runtime sidecar service account via IRSA and audit trail for key usage to security S3 bucket.

sam: For IRSA I'll create an IAM role bound to serviceAccount runtime-sidecar-sa in namespace runtime. Policy will include kms:Decrypt, GenerateDataKey*, Encrypt scoped to the key ARN. I can draft PR.

kelly: Heads-up from oncall: add a canary toggle. Do not switch all traffic at once. Also include rollback/runbook steps so oncall can flip back quickly.

neha: Canary plan: 5% traffic on new image, 2h soak with checks: latency P95, error-rate, and decryption-failures metric. Auto-rollback if decryption-failures > 0.5% or any increase in 5xxs. Runbook already has a rollback section.

infra-bot: image-scan: Found 1 HIGH (libcurl CVE-2025-1234) and 3 MED issues in current base. Recommendation: update system libcurl or switch to patched base image.

sec-triage-bot: CVE-2025-1234 flagged critical for our runtime image. Is the rebuild including the distro patch for libcurl?

neha: Yes — bumping base to ubuntu-minimal:22.04-patch-2025-03 which includes the libcurl fix and several distro hardening patches. Also plan to remove setuid binaries and strip debug symbols.

neha: ```Dockerfile
FROM ubuntu-minimal:22.04-patch-2025-03
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates libcurl4=7.80.0-1 && \n    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY --from=builder /app /app
USER 1000
```

owen: Looks good. For audit logs, add a CloudTrail event selector for KMS and enable data events for the security bucket. I'll open infra PR to update CloudTrail and add S3 bucket policy to allow cross-account log write.

sam: PRs queued: aws-iam/PR#412 (IRSA policy), infra-logging/PR#211 (CloudTrail + bucket policy), eng-runtime/PR#88 (image rebuild + Dockerfile). Linking them here for review.

neha: Tagging @sec for final sign-off. If no blockers by EOD we'll schedule the rebuild at 01:00 UTC.

kelly: Oncall ack — I'll be on the rollout window and can trigger rollback if we hit thresholds.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: image-rebuild job queued for 2025-11-20T01:00:00Z. Will run canary rollout at 5% then escalate on success.
